items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I became a composer for Decca because Mr. Perez asked me.

ctx.x: I started - I made myself a composer before we - Cugat - that I recorded "El Negro a Reza" and I forgot the title of the other number and then I became a composer for Decca because Mr. Perez asked me. Ahh - he liked "Sopa de Pichon" and "La Paella", so we recorded and became two hits. As a matter of fact, they was playing "La Paella" and "Sopa de Pichon" in Havana and all through Cuba; and we recorded in 1942 and the recording was playing until 1946, that I was there.
In 1942 you did all those recordings?
